reviews.title: FIVE STARS!

And most stuff in the shop has two options for paying, you can spend real money on it or just moonstones that you can earn. I got VIP after a few weeks! You can earn OP rewards In only hours! This game is so cool, yet provides good quests at all levels! The open world is quite large, their even is floating islands for when you get a flying animal such as dragon, or legendary animals. The chat does not allow bullying and you can’t even type mean things which is good. If you get this game, have fun!

reviews.title: Love wolf tales 🐺🐾🌙
reviews.text:
I love this game! I have some suggestions tho. Maybe you could make the apexes a little easier so everyone feels included. And also, maybe you don’t need to have VIP to make a guild. If you could get something like moonstones, meat, or a free rare wolf after completing two chapters in a week, or something like that, it would be great. Anyways, love wolves, you should get this game.

Edit: In PvP some people are a little unfair. Sometimes I get curious to see what happens when you fake going afk (Now I see it was wrong 😑) and some people don’t attack you, and other people just take advantage of it! Also, in PvP some people have the buddies (animals that follow you) and they ATTACK!!! Plus in the PvP Odd pup game someone on my team kept bringing the cub to the front of our safe zone and no one could find it!😤 Sometimes on PvP I had abilities equipped, they were gone! And so I tried to exit PvP, but when you exit, it just kills you and you’re back in the PvP! So it just wastes five minutes of my time.

Sometimes people spam emotes and somehow the sticker gets really big, even if you hide stickers.

Also for people who play already that don’t know, if you go to the play tab and go to quests, it has a little story for each chapter. I’m a sucker for lore, aren’t you? Okay love this bye ✌️
(My bad this was a LOT 😂 Egg on my face)
